name: Unconfirmed features probe
description: CONFIRMED 2026-10-12: stat_curve, pp_curve, store_stock, and now the rule for movement_slots - an OCCUPIED movement slot can be rewritten, an EMPTY one cannot be filled. Evidence: Fly into Sonic's empty slot 2 granted nothing; Dash into that same empty slot granted nothing either (two abilities, same empty slot, same result); while Fly into his OCCUPIED slot 1 removed his Dash, shown by the Green Hill dash panel reading greyed at level 1 where vanilla Sonic can use it. The player had already seen the positive half functionally - Shadow given Fly in his occupied slot 2 crossed a Green Hill fly point playing his teleport animation. This matches the POW-move rule confirmed 2026-10-11, where a move's animation, minigame and hit count stay with the combo.GDA slot while its data is replaced: performances are addressed per character per slot index, so there is no slot-N performance for a slot the character never had. This build applies the rule instead of testing it. Sonic is back to VANILLA so he keeps the Dash the opening dash gate needs - he was stranded there, alone, because Amy had not joined yet and only one of his slots can hold anything. Amy carries the Fly test instead, in her occupied slot 1 (vanilla Smash), with her occupied slot 2 rewritten from Dash to Smash so the party loses nothing: Dash from Sonic, Smash from Amy, Fly from Amy, all from level 1, which is a superset of vanilla. The open question is now only whether a rewritten slot's ability is functional for a character other than Shadow, and Amy is the only flyer until Tails joins, which is the window to test it in. The save carries movement-ability level (offset 0x026E1), so run this from a NEW GAME. shop_prices puts every shop row at 1 ring; xp_rate 3 is a convenience.
